summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically captures and organizes conversations into layered memory, recalls relevant memory context for future turns, and exposes memory_search and conversation_search tools for structured memory and raw conversation lookup.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Repository evidence shows this plugin is a DeepSeek Harness extension that adds long-term, cross-session memory support by automatically capturing conversations and maintaining a four-layer memory pipeline (L0 raw logs, L1 atomic memory, L2 scene blocks, L3 persona), while offering tools for structured memory search and raw conversation retrieval; it is implemented as a DSH bundle plugin and relies on local storage plus optional remote embedding services for hybrid recall.
